findings.message: The unquoted heredoc preserves \" as literal backslash-quote characters, so the generated probe runs `command -v \"jq\"`, looking for a binary whose name includes quotes. This returns nothing even when jq is installed, causing every GCE verification to fail with `missing_binary:jq` before reaching gemini. Remove the backslashes around `${binary}` while retaining the escaped command substitution.
